notes: HamsterToken (src/HamsterToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20: name HAMSTER, symbol HAMSTER, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 HAMSTER (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory; INITIAL_HOLDER records that address. totalSupply() is a compile-time constant: there is no mint, burn, burnFrom, pause, blocklist, freeze, seize, owner, upgrade hook, fee, tax or exemption list, so the supply can neither grow nor shrink and every transfer moves exactly the amount stated. Transfers and approvals to the zero address revert; an allowance of type(uint256).max is unlimited. The token vendors no library and its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no application contracts. Pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only. Economics are the requester's: 70% of the supply seeds the pool at a 2,500 IMD opening cap and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0x1ee3ffadfe138415a2ddaedeebe5f46616fa413d. The swarm's share is taken by the factory and is not written here.
